author: DamiLee
description: Trantor and Coruscant are both ecumenopolises, but they grow in opposite directions—one digs downward beneath a fixed imperial dome, while the other endlessly builds new mega-levels above. Over time, both create extreme vertical stratification shaped by access to light, power, planning, and control. Is a planet-wide city destined to become a vertical trap?
title: Trantor vs Coruscant
